newsitem.title: UK: Lufthansa adds flights to Lagos.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa adds flights to Lagos.

text.p: Lufthansa AG said it will operate extra flights from Frankfurt to Lagos in July and August to accommodate extra demand resulting from the continued suspension of direct flights between the UK and Nigeria.

Five additional same day return flights are scheduled on July 17, 20, 24, 27, 31 and August 31 using an Airbus A310-300 aircraft with a cargo uplift of six tonnes and a three class 169 seat passenger configuration.
Lufthansa said it has set flight timres to ensure optimum connection with flights from the UK to and Frankfurt.
The airline already operates four scheduled weekly flights to Lagos, two non-stop and two via Accra in Ghana.
